post.description: Tenant fields in the body or headers are ignored: the key decides the organization and project. Subject to the organization’s daily quota (`429 QUOTA_EXCEEDED`, `Retry-After` until 00:00 UTC). Full contract: docs/ingestion-api.md.

session.name: aop_sid
session.description: HttpOnly session cookie set by register/login (`__Host-aop_sid` in production).

secret.description: Full key `aop_<keyId>.<secret>`. Shown once, never again.

threshold.description: Ratio (0–1) for error_rate; milliseconds for p95_latency.

lastValue.description: null = no data in the window.

errorSummary.description: Safe summary; response bodies are never kept.

urlPreview.description: Scheme and host only; the full URL is never returned.

id.description: Stable entry ID within the result set.

TelemetryBatch.description: At most 500 records in total and 1 MiB per request.
